lines.text: Use a stopping note, shorter tasks, and written call confirmations when thinking is unreliable.
Give urgent deadlines a separate plan.

items.text: Write the matter's name and deadline at the top of one page.
Name the next visible action, such as finding a policy letter.
Gather only the documents needed for that action.
Choose a way to record the outcome without holding it in memory.
Before stopping, note what happened and where to resume.
For a close deadline, assign a backup person or request an extension now.

line.text: Built for the difficulty rather than the diagnosis, and it never asks why holding a plan in your head is unreliable right now.
